NOTICE OF HEARING AND TEMPORARY RESTRAINING ORDER (ELDER OR DEPENDENT ADULT ABUSE)
Off Calendar Feb-16-2011 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on calendar today for Elder Adult Abuse OSC and TRO hearing this day.

Dept. 204. Judge Pro Tem: Sue Kaplan. Court Reporter: Diana Chen, CSR# 11312. Clerk: Jacqueline Alameda. Bailiff: Deputy C. Garcia.

The announcement as to Commissioner Sue Kaplan sitting as the Judge Pro Tem was made in open court. There being no objection, the matter was called.

Petitioner: Bo Shun Chen was present with Counsel Judy Hitchcock, of Legal Assistance for the Elderly, who was assisted in Cantonese/Toisanese/English translation by Cynthia Li (APS Social Worker).

Respondent: Jack Lu was not present.

Bo Shun Chen was sworn.

The Court hears testimony, receives evidence and after hearing the evidence presented, the Petitioner's order is Granted as follows: Respondent shall stay at least 100 yards away from the protected person: Bo Shun Chen and his Residence.

Respondent shall not Physically Abuse, Financially Abuse, Intimidate, Molest, Attack, Assault (sexually or otherwise), Hit, Follow, Stalk, Threaten, Harass, Destroy Personal Property, Keep under Surveillance, or Block Movements, Contact (directly or indirectly), Telephone, Send Messages, Mail or e-Mail, Take Any Action, Directly or Through Others, to
Obtain the Addresses or Locations of the Protected Persons.

Respondent must move out immediately from and not return to: 2032 Palou Ave., San Francisco, CA, 94124.

No Guns or Other Firearms/Turn In or Sell Guns or Firearms.

Expires: February 16, 2014.

Order signed.
